name: Sakutarou
source: Sakutarou is a stuffed lion doll handmade by Rosa and given to Maria for her birthday. He became Maria's furniture when she gave him a soul through magic. His name was originally intended to be "Sakura", but since "Sakura" is traditionally a female name, Maria derived from it and added the male suffix tarou.
